Bulgarian

[edit]
Bulgarian Wikipedia has an article on:
интернет
Wikipedia bg

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English Internet.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈintɛrnɛt]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -intɛrnɛt
  • Syllabification(key): ин‧тер‧нет

Noun

[edit]

и́нтернет • (ínternet) m (relational adjective интерне́тен or интерне́тски)

  1. Internet

Declension

[edit]
Declension of и́нтернет
singular
indefinite и́нтернет
ínternet
definite
(subject form) 		и́нтернетът
ínternetǎt
definite
(object form) 		и́нтернета
ínterneta

See also

[edit]
  • нет (net)

Eastern Mari

[edit]

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian интерне́т (intɛrnɛ́t).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /inteɾˈnet/
  • Rhymes: -et
  • Hyphenation: ин‧тер‧нет

Noun

[edit]

интернет • (interńet) (computing)

  1. Internet

Macedonian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English Internet.

Pronunciation

[edit]

  • Hyphenation: ин‧тер‧нет

Noun

интернет • (internet) m

  1. Internet

Russian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • ине́т (inɛ́t) — slang

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English Internet.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ɪntɨrˈnɛt] (phonetic respelling: интэрнэ́т)
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

интерне́т • (intɛrnɛ́t) m inan (genitive интерне́та, nominative plural интерне́ты, genitive plural интерне́тов, relational adjective интерне́тный)

  1. Internet
    Ско́лько вы вчера́ сиде́ли в интерне́те?
    Skólʹko vy včerá sidéli v intɛrnɛ́te?
    How long did you hang out on the Internet yesterday?

Usage notes

[edit]

The plural form интерне́ты (intɛrnɛ́ty) is used in a humorous way, like English internets.

[edit]
